attributes.name: logo tile treatment
attributes.definition: Whether partner/sponsor logos are each enclosed in a distinct tile/container and how that container is styled.

values.definition: Each logo sits in its own tile with rounded corners (bordered or not).
Each logo sits in its own tile with square corners.
Logos sit directly on the page or a band with no individual tile.

attributes.name: logo grid density and size
attributes.definition: How densely partner/sponsor logos are packed and how large they appear.

values.definition: Many small logos packed in a tight multi-column grid.
Small logos, not necessarily in a dense multi-column grid.
Large logos of uniform size with generous spacing.

attributes.name: logo section background
attributes.definition: The background treatment of the area that holds partner/sponsor logos.

values.definition: Logos sit on a full-width plain white band.
Logos sit in tiles over the ordinary page background.

attributes.name: logo alignment within tile
attributes.definition: Horizontal alignment of logos within their container.

values.definition: Logos are aligned to the left edge of their container.
